{{Top|leg}}
'''Pesticide''' was a chemical used to kill [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. The [[TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid]] used [[pesticide dispenser]]s to deal with harmful insects while protecting crops,<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> and the [[R0/5T.N1 tree feeder]] was capable of releasing pesticides through an [[adjustable sprayer nozzle]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Deezoth Caraz]] was killed when his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Vok]], slipped [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] pesticide into his drink.<ref name="GTLAA">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
